_comment: 8d C1/D1 (issue #14/#15) Yvlon Byres, standing with Ceria/Ksmvr at dungeon_approach. Canon (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Yvlon_Byres): silver-armed [Armsmistress]-line warrior (a sword-and-armor fighter, NOT a mage class), blunt-kind register -- protective without sentiment (character-profiles.md). No gate of her own (Ceria owns the party-formed beat) -- a single hub whose text_variants carry the pool bark (default), the halls-anticipating bark (once the party has formed and the trap gauntlet is the next real step), and the post-victory line, ascending order, LAST-satisfied-wins.

hub.speaker: Yvlon
hub.text: Stay behind my shield arm if it goes bad. Not out of charity — I just hate digging graves.

text_variants.text: Dust this thick means nothing's walked here in years. Or the thing that walks here doesn't leave tracks.
Solid work back there. You'd pass for a second-string Silver-rank. That's a compliment. Take it.
